visualCharacteristics.purpose: Data tables for ingredient and constituent disclosures
visualCharacteristics.layout: Full width, every cell bordered, no zebra stripes, bold header row; scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports

contentPattern.structure: each block row is a table row and each cell a table cell; the first row is the header unless 'no-header' is set

reuseGuidance: Use for any tabular data. Keep the 'Table x-y' caption as a bold paragraph before the block. Use 'no-header' when the first row is data (e.g. bold labels in the first column only).
